schedule.name: BASELINE
schedule.prompt: Sit comfortably. Breathe normally. Eyes soft-focus on a fixed point. Stay still. (2 min)

schedule.name: STIM1_ARITHMETIC
schedule.prompt: STIMULUS 1 — Count backwards from 1000 by 7s OUT LOUD for 60 seconds. Begin NOW.

schedule.name: RECOVERY1
schedule.prompt: Stop counting. Relax. Breathe normally. (2 min recovery)

schedule.name: STIM2_BREATHHOLD
schedule.prompt: STIMULUS 2 — Exhale fully, then HOLD your breath for 30-45 seconds. Resume normal breathing when uncomfortable.

schedule.name: RECOVERY2
schedule.prompt: Recovery — eyes closed, meditation posture, breath natural. (4 min)

schedule.name: STIM3_ARITHMETIC
schedule.prompt: STIMULUS 3 (replication) — Count backwards from 999 by 13s OUT LOUD for 60 seconds. Begin NOW.

schedule.name: STIM4_BREATHHOLD
schedule.prompt: STIMULUS 4 (replication) — Exhale fully, HOLD 30-45 seconds. Resume.

schedule.name: CLOSING_MEDITATION
schedule.prompt: Closing meditation — eyes closed, breath natural, no task. (6 min)

schedule.name: SESSION_END
schedule.prompt: Session complete. Remove headband. Stop the script with Ctrl+C if it doesn't auto-stop.
